description_zh: 调用DeleteRouteDistributionStrategy删除路由发布策略
kebab_example: aliyun smartag delete-route-distribution-strategy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-gyat6giidkvyk0000 --dest-cidr-block 192.XX.XX.0/24 --source-type local --route-source STATIC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRouteDistributionStrategy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the route source. Valid values:

cloud: Alibaba Cloud
local: on-premises network
parameters.help_zh:
路由来源类型：

cloud：云上路由。

local：线下路由
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of routes. Valid values:

Alibaba Cloud

    *   Virtual private cloud (VPC) IDs: Routes that are learned from VPCs.
    *   Virtual border router (VBR) IDs: Routes that are learned from VBRs.
    *   SAG instance IDs: Routes that are learned from SAG instances.

On-premises network

    *   STATIC: Static routes that are specified in the SAG console.
    *   OSPF: Routes that are learned through the Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) protocol.
    *   BGP: Routes that are learned through Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
parameters.help_zh:
路由来源：
云上路由
    - 专有网络（VPC）实例ID：通过VPC学来的路由。
    - 虚拟边界路由器（VBR）实例ID：通过VBR学来的路由。
    - 智能接入网关（SAG）实例ID：通过SAG学来的路由。
线下路由
    - STATIC：通过管理控制台添加的静态路由。
    - OSPF：通过OSPF路由协议学习来的路由。
    - BGP：通过BGP路由协议学习来的路由
parameters.name: route_source
